areas.area-auth: authentication, authorization, OAuth, OIDC, and access token validation
areas.area-commandlinetools: Command line tools, dotnet-dev-certs, dotnet-user-jwts, and OpenAPI

areas.area-infrastructure: MSBuild projects/targets, build scripts, CI, Installers and shared framework
areas.area-middleware: URL rewrite, redirect, response cache/compression, session, and other general middlewares
areas.area-minimal: Includes minimal APIs, endpoint filters, parameter binding, request delegate generator etc
areas.area-mvc: MVC, Actions and Controllers, Localization, CORS, most templates
areas.area-networking: Includes servers, yarp, json patch, bedrock, websockets, http client factory, and http abstractions
areas.area-security: antiforgery, CSP, and security features other than authentication and authorization
